enterprise-foundation.validation: Require accessible evidence, a valid effective interval and an independent approver when the policy requires separation. Reject an overlapping approved version rather than replacing it.
enterprise-foundation.outcome: Record the approved master-data version and decision evidence. Application to consumers is a separately observable handoff, not proof that all consumers have adopted it.

finance.validation: Validate the approved source version, entity/ledger/period, balanced totals, dimensions, exchange-rate reference and source operation uniqueness through Accounting.
finance.outcome: Complete only after Accounting returns the durable journal reference and reconciled control totals. A queued request cannot be displayed as a posted journal.

controlling.validation: Require compatible immutable snapshots and complete allocation drivers. Define zero-driver and rounding-residual behavior; a simulation never posts ledger adjustments.
controlling.outcome: Publish scenario outputs, residuals and source lineage. Approval and actual posting remain separate actions under the owning policy.

sales-and-crm.validation: Require a current accepted quote snapshot, authorized seller entity, resolvable customer/product mappings and a reviewed target order owner. Revalidate expired or superseded commercial terms.
sales-and-crm.outcome: Link the accepted downstream order/subscription reference. A timeout remains pending until queried or reconciled using the original handoff identity.

revenue-operations.validation: Require a closed reviewed usage window, deduplicated source events, explicit units/timezone and the approved rating/pricing snapshot. Late usage follows the correction policy.
revenue-operations.outcome: Billing owns invoice finalization and returns its reference. Financial revenue recognition remains Accounting-owned and is not implied by invoicing.

procurement.validation: Validate the receiving actor/location, order line, units and quantity/tolerance policy. The owning stock/receipt service records physical movements; reject duplicate receipt identities.
procurement.outcome: Link the receipt and outstanding quantities. A partial receipt does not close the order or release an unmatched supplier invoice for payment.

inventory-and-logistics.validation: Require authorized destination custody, correct units and lot/serial policy, and conserved dispatched/received/in-transit quantities. Validate the movement identity at the selected stock owner.
inventory-and-logistics.outcome: Record received quantities and discrepancies separately. Financial valuation is a linked Accounting event, not a direct write from the receiving UI.

projects-and-services.validation: Require accepted scope, approved time/expenses, valid billing terms and customer/delegate evidence. Preserve the accepted snapshot across retries.
projects-and-services.outcome: Link the Billing invoice reference and reconcile its basis. A billing request can pass through billing_requested before confirmed invoicing.

body.resolution_summary: Approved recovery completed and service checks passed.

service-management.validation: Require resolution authority and evidence for the selected service/entitlement. Keep customer-visible resolution text separate from restricted internal notes; validate any linked change authority.
service-management.outcome: Record the resolution and SLA outcome. Closure and any later reopening preserve the earlier resolution evidence and are separate lifecycle actions.

hosting-and-cloud.validation: Validate entitlement, allowed region, capacity, approved template and change authority. Payloads contain secret references only where required, never provider credentials.
hosting-and-cloud.outcome: Control Panel returns an observed resource reference and outcome. Partial creation retains created-resource and compensation evidence until reconciled.

product-and-engineering.validation: Bind approval to the immutable artifact, required test/security evidence and rollout readiness. Changed or expired evidence invalidates the review instead of carrying approval to another artifact.
product-and-engineering.outcome: Record release authorization for this artifact. Actual deployment, rollout results and rollback evidence remain separately reported operations.

people.validation: Require authorized HR context, consistent assignment dates and the applicable offboarding policy. Restrict employment, compensation and other sensitive fields independently of ordinary team membership.
people.outcome: End the effective assignment and expose outstanding access/equipment recovery obligations. The employment outcome does not claim all downstream access was successfully revoked.

assets-and-facilities.validation: Validate the receiving custodian, authorized location, required inspection and current custody version. Conflicting concurrent acceptance must not create two current custodians.
assets-and-facilities.outcome: Record the accepted custody transition. Damage/discrepancy and financial capitalization/disposal stay with their respective owner workflows.

body.finding_summary: Required approval evidence is incomplete for the reviewed sample.

governance-risk-and-compliance.validation: Require independent review authority, accessible immutable evidence and a valid remediation owner. Preserve control/framework version and legal-hold/retention obligations.
governance-risk-and-compliance.outcome: Record the finding and linked remediation obligation without changing the original source audit evidence. Remediation acceptance is a distinct reviewed action.

partners-and-portals.validation: Require authority over the exact principal/resource scope. A partner relationship alone does not grant revocation or delegation rights across other organizations.
partners-and-portals.outcome: Record revocation and track downstream acknowledgements/session-cache invalidation. Keep delayed revocations visible until protected operations enforce the change.

data-and-intelligence.validation: Authorize every source, row/field and selected entity, then record metric versions and freshness policy. Reject or visibly qualify an incomplete source snapshot according to the report definition.
data-and-intelligence.outcome: Produce a permission-scoped report artifact with expiry and lineage. Recheck authorization on download, even if the report was authorized when queued.
